correctness.rationale: At zero selection, the Fermi probability is exactly 1/2, so the two independent copy indicators have rates a=p_s/2 and b=p_g/2. Conditional drifts close on empirical marginal products and joint frequencies, yielding the bounded martingale xy+theta(z-xy). A uniformly positive probability of a designated sequence of dual copies proves almost-sure fixation. The martingale terminal identity yields the full multi-label joint law, the finite-time expectation formula and the distinct-model sampling robustness. Strict derivative signs yield the sharp bound theta<=1/(N+1). Packaged standard-library exact rationals pass 1,230 harmonic cases and 88 separate absorbing-chain solves; finite checks supplement, not establish, arbitrary N.

value.rationale: The natural quantity is the exact probability that independently copied game and behavior both survive in specified categories, which the motivating source compares numerically under payoff selection. The finding gives the entire finite-N terminal contingency table from arbitrary paired initial labels, distinguishes neutral ancestry-induced association from payoff bias, proves no new association can appear when initial contingency is factorized, and quantifies its sharp O(1/N) strength. This is a motivated exact law rather than a small arbitrary numeric case or a routine normalization check.
